descricao: Kontour Medical is a medical technology company dedicated to developing and manufacturing patient-specific implant solutions and advanced biomaterial-based medical devices. With a focus on cranial, maxillofacial, thoracic, and neurosurgical applications, we work closely with surgeons, healthcare institutions, and global partners to support precise, reliable surgical repair and improve patient care.

produtos.nome: Kontour Cranial Fixation and Reparation Systems
produtos.descricao: Made from British Invibio® PEEK-OPTIMA® polymer, a high-performance biomaterial that meets the strictest implant standards. It features excellent mechanical properties, ease of shaping, chemical stability, and biocompatibility. It can withstand high-temperature steam and radiation sterilization and has radiolucency, making it widely used in cardiovascular, dental, neurosurgery, maxillofacial surgery, and orthopedic implants.
